lineage: fidelity probe p01_flexgrid, 2026-09-24 (promoted by WP-G G-2, 2026-09-25)
notes: Findings F2b/F2c/F2d (docs/engine/fidelity/01-FINDINGS.md): label|value rows in flexbox, a CSS grid of stat
cards, icon-badge takeaways, a flex KPI strip and a four-column label|description grid - the side-by-side
constructs the side-by-side package (B) fixed. The HTML is the probe's but for one line: the heading has
width:872px, to the right edge of layout-06's title zone (48 + 864 = 912). The probe's shrink-to-fit bold
title is drawn by the browser in the
manifest's major font (Calibri Light, emboldened synthetically at 700, advances unchanged) and written +mj-lt b=1, which PowerPoint resolves
through test-16x9's theme part to Calibri Bold, ~3 % wider: fit's overhang rule flagged it (+5 px on
2026-09-25). That is the test masters' manifest/theme mismatch (plan 5's uncovered list; G-1 open item 14,
D item 17), not this family's subject, so the title gets the room its zone gives it; the weights family keeps
a bold Calibri-Light title on purpose. The heading maps to the title placeholder by its data-placeholder=title
(map_placeholders pass 1: its line fits the zone); geometry would agree, 84 % of its box inside the zone

(pass 2, >= 60 %); the mapping is asserted, not only documented: test_torture.test_the_listed_placeholders_are_the_mapped_ones holds every elements[] entry that names a placeholder (or null), and its startsWith.
Counts follow 01-MASTER-BRIEF.md 11 as amended by WP-B (plan D14): a text element is a maximal run of
consecutive, vertically stacked, horizontally overlapping in-flow sibling blocks and anonymous inline runs,
whose content is inline-only, under one parent, with no intervening non-text sibling; each block or run is
one paragraph; two items of one flex or grid container stack only where that layout stacks them (never in a
flex row; in a grid only within the same column tracks); an out-of-flow block starts its own element.
text 37 = title 1 + A 11 + B 6 + C 6 + D 5 + E 8:
A (.panel): '.t' Key metrics is 1 - its next sibling is a .row, a flex layout and not an inline-only text
block, so the run ends there; each of the five .row flex rows splits into its two items, label and value
(never stacked in a flex row) = 10. Each value is its own element aligned 'right': its line box sits at
the row's right edge (justify-content:space-between; B's derived alignment).
B (.grid, 3 x 2 cards): each card's .num and .lbl are in-flow blocks that stack inside the card = 1 element
of 2 paragraphs per card, 6. Two cards' texts never merge: they have different parents (11: under one parent).
C (.list): per .item the badge's number is its own element (the badge is a decorated flex item; its text is
centred both ways, align center / anchor middle, from the flex-centred line box), and '.txt' is 1 element
of 2 paragraphs - the display:block <b> heading and the anonymous run after it stack (lines 1 + 2) = 2 x 3.
'.txt' starts at x 966 = item 920 + border 4 + padding 10 + badge 22 + gap 10, not at the item's edge (F2d).
D (.kpis): each .kpi is a column flex box whose .n and .l stack = 1 element of 2 centred paragraphs, x 5.
E (.dl): 8 grid cells, 8 elements - side by side along a row, and each row's first cell sits in another
column track than the cell before it in document order, so nothing stacks (rows.html's 'dl' rule).
shape 26 = A 6 + B 6 + C 9 + D 5: A the panel's roundRect fill + one 1 px border-bottom rect per .row (5);
B one roundRect per card; C per .item its roundRect fill, its 4 px left border (a per-side border is a shape
of its own) and the badge's 22 px circle (roundRect) = 3 x 3; D one roundRect per .kpi. Nothing is rastered.
Line counts were measured in Edge with the master's theme fonts forced (Calibri / Calibri Light); a different
font re-breaks them, the element and paragraph counts are structural and do not move.

gateMaxPx2 986 = 822 px2 masked, measured 2026-09-25 on main 4ab1be8 (fidelity-w2 + X, plan 16 #22) + G-2, references rendered in Calibri / Calibri Light; two runs, identical, + 20 % (Peter #16, plan 11). Of it:

all 822 px2 are the title - test-16x9's manifest/theme mismatch (G-1 open item 14, D item 17): the browser draws the 700 heading in Calibri Light with synthetic bold, advances unchanged (Edge, measured in weights' notes), while PptxRender, like PowerPoint, draws the file's +mj-lt b=1 through the theme part's major font as Calibri Bold, ~3 % wider and heavier. Every row, card, badge, KPI and grid cell is clean at the gate's settings (blur 2, delta E 8, 60 px2 minimum area),
which cannot see one loss on 11 px text. G-2 review m3 (.card .lbl{opacity:.85}, dropped silently until r1a): each
label is merged with its card's .num into one element of 2 paragraphs, so the block's own opacity cannot be the
element's; since r1a (plan 16 #25) it is on the label's runs, which export at FFFFFF alpha 85000 over 0B2545 as
the browser composites them, the numbers at alpha 1 (test_rows.test_flexgrid_labels_keep_their_opacity).

gateMaxPx2 987 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 822 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
